data.title: Step 2: allow *"I don't know"*
data.subtitle: Step 2 of 6 in the self-check loop.

items: Paste your material and the finish line
Give it permission to say "I don't know"
Ask it to tag guesses as [GUESS]
Ask for its questions at the end

blocks.text: Do the task. If something isn't in my material, say "I don't know" or tag it [GUESS]. Don't fill gaps.
**You'll get back:** the draft, with [GUESS] tags and your questions at the end.
Use it with your notes or files attached.

items: A short list of questions for you

blocks.new: Flag anything that's missing. I'll fill it.

blocks.text: Anthropic says giving Claude permission to say **I don't know** can drastically reduce false information.
